purpose: Interpret exposed operation records as transport bindings to named language-neutral decision procedures.

request_contract.operation_identity: Each exposed operation identifier resolves to the same procedure_identifier in the decision contract catalogs. Names shared by different owners remain distinct operations.
request_contract.arguments: Bind named and positional inputs by the declared name and position. Reject an omitted required argument. Supply the declared default only for omission; explicit null is a supplied value.
request_contract.type_unions: A union permits any one of its declared member shapes. An optional member adds null; it does not imply arbitrary text conversion.
request_contract.variadic_bindings: Variadic positional arguments retain their order. Variadic named arguments retain their names. The operation procedure determines which additional names are accepted.
request_contract.transport_verbs: Enforce the declared allowed verb set before executing business behavior. Generic registration defaults do not imply that every verb is safe to cache or retry.
request_contract.anonymous_registration: An anonymous registration allows invocation without a logged-in session at the transport gate only. The operation may require a separate token, signature, challenge, or object-level authorization.
request_contract.permissions: Apply session permissions, object permissions, field restrictions, and any explicit procedure checks. An observed access helper name is not an exhaustive authorization model.
request_contract.transaction: State-changing service effects follow the enclosing request transaction contract, including rollback on unhandled failures and any explicitly declared commit boundary.

response_contract.return_shapes: Return-shape records describe values returned along recorded branches. A mapping identifies named members; ordered collections preserve order; no_value is a successful result without a business value.
response_contract.computed_result: Resolve a computed result by executing the linked procedure and its referenced record or helper contract. Do not infer a scalar type from a variable name.
response_contract.errors: Business validation, permission denial, missing record, conflict, and external service failures remain distinct outcomes. Apply the documented remote error envelope after the procedure decides the outcome.
response_contract.binary_or_download: Download and generated-document responses use the report and export contract, including content kind, filename, encoding, authorization, and cleanup.

retry_contract.read_only: A successful read can be repeated subject to changing data and access.
retry_contract.write: Do not automatically repeat a write after a transport timeout unless the operation defines a stable request identity or an observable existing-result lookup. A timeout may occur after commit.
retry_contract.background_work: For queued work, retain the job identity and expose its terminal success or failure; queue acceptance does not mean the accounting effect is posted.
